title: B.Tech IT FAP Rules
content: The Flexible Academic Program (FAP) allows IT branch students to choose 3 open electives in their 6th semester. A minimum CGPA of 7.5 is required to opt for cross-departmental electives from ECE or Management. Students below 7.5 CGPA must choose from within the IT basket only. FAP registration opens in Week 2 of Semester 5.

title: C3 Exam Weightage Guidelines
content: The IIITA continuous assessment system: C1 carries 20% weightage (mid-semester test), C2 carries 50% weightage (end-semester examination), and C3 carries 30% weightage (assignments, quizzes, and lab evaluations). This applies to all B.Tech programmes. C3 marks are submitted by the course instructor by the end of Week 15.

title: 75% Attendance Policy Strict Enforcement
content: Students with attendance below 75% in any subject will be categorically debarred from sitting in the end-semester C2 examinations without exception. A medical exemption requires a registered doctor's certificate submitted to the Dean's office within 3 days of the absence. Repeated absentees will be reported to their guardian.

title: Grade Appeal and Re-evaluation Process
content: Students wishing to appeal their C2 grade must submit a written application to the Academic Section within 7 days of result declaration. A re-evaluation fee of Rs. 500 per subject applies. The final re-evaluated mark, whether higher or lower, will be recorded. Grade appeals for C1 and C3 must be raised directly with the course instructor.

title: Semester Registration Procedure
content: Semester registration opens on the ERP portal (erp.iiita.ac.in) 2 weeks before the semester start. Students must clear all pending dues before registration. Course selection must be approved by the faculty advisor. Late registration incurs a fine of Rs. 200/day up to 5 days, after which the student requires Dean approval.

title: PhD Course Work Requirements
content: PhD scholars at IIITA must complete a minimum of 6 course credits in their first two semesters. A minimum GPA of 7.0 is required in each course. Comprehensive examination (Pre-PhD) must be cleared within 18 months of joining. PhD students are assigned a faculty supervisor and a Doctoral Committee for guidance.

title: Branch Change Policy (Confidential)
content: Branch change from ECE or IT-Business to IT is permitted after Semester 2 subject to: (a) CGPA above 9.0, (b) Vacancy in the target branch, (c) Approval of both HoDs. Only 5% of branch strength can be changed in any academic year. Rejected applications are final for that academic year. This is a confidential administrative process.

title: Academic Integrity & Plagiarism Policy
content: IIITA enforces a strict zero-tolerance policy on academic dishonesty. Plagiarism in assignments above 30% (as detected by Turnitin) results in a zero grade for the submission. A second offence leads to an F grade in the course. Cheating in examinations leads to debarment from the semester examinations and a disciplinary committee hearing.

title: Placement Portal: Season 2025-26 Overview
content: Placement Season 2025-26 is now open. Companies registered include Google-Jhalwa, TCS, Amazon, Infosys, and Microsoft. Year-3 students must complete their resume on the CDC portal (cdc.iiita.ac.in) by June 15, 2026. Year-4 and final-year students are eligible for current JAFs. PPOs and internship conversions from Summer 2025 are being processed. Contact CDC office: CC-3, Room 104.

title: JAF: Google-Jhalwa SWE Intern
content: Google-Jhalwa is offering Software Engineering Internships. Base stipend: 1.5 LPM. Eligibility: Final-year (Year-4) IT branch students with no active backlogs and CGPA above 8.0. Selection process: Online coding round (LeetCode-style) → 2 technical interviews → HR round. Apply via CDC portal before April 30, 2026.

title: JAF: TCS NQT National Qualifier
content: TCS National Qualifier Test (NQT) is open to all final-year B.Tech students regardless of branch. CTC: 3.36 LPA (TCS Digital: 7 LPA). Minimum CGPA: 6.0. Test includes Verbal Ability, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, and Programming Logic. Date: May 20, 2026. Register on TCS iON before May 10.

title: JAF: Amazon SDE Internship
content: Amazon is recruiting SDE Interns for Summer 2026. Stipend: 1.2 LPM + accommodation. Eligibility: Year-3 IT and ECE students, CGPA above 7.5, proficiency in DSA. Online assessment: 2 coding problems (90 min) + work simulation. Shortlisted candidates get 2 technical rounds. Apply via CDC by May 5, 2026.

title: CDC Internship Conversion Guidelines
content: Students who received Summer 2025 internship offers have until July 15, 2026 to submit conversion confirmation to CDC. PPO students must maintain CGPA above the offer threshold. Any change in CTC or joining date must be reported immediately. CDC will not mediate disputes post-acceptance. Contact: cdc@iiita.ac.in

title: BH-1 Hostel Rules & Regulations
content: BH-1 In-time: 10:00 PM on weekdays, 11:00 PM on weekends. Guests are not permitted inside the hostel after 8:00 PM. All outing requests beyond 11 PM must be submitted on the hostel portal and approved by the Warden. Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited. Ragging is a criminal offence and will lead to immediate expulsion. Mess timings: Breakfast 7-9 AM, Lunch 12-2 PM, Dinner 7-9 PM. Room inspections occur on the 1st of every month.

title: GH-1 Hostel Rules & Regulations
content: GH-1 Girls Hostel In-time: 9:00 PM on weekdays, 10:00 PM on weekends. Male visitors are strictly not allowed inside the hostel premises at any time. Outing beyond 9 PM requires prior written permission from parents and warden. Biometric attendance at entry gate is mandatory. CCTV surveillance is active 24x7. Mess timings: Breakfast 7-8:30 AM, Lunch 12-1:30 PM, Dinner 7-8:30 PM.

title: Hostel Outing & Leave Application Process
content: Students must apply for home leave on the Hostel Portal (hostel.iiita.ac.in) at least 24 hours in advance. Required: Guardian confirmation SMS, warden approval, and local guardian contact if destination is within 50km. Weekend outings (Fri-Sun) do not require special approval but must be logged. Medical emergencies: Warden must be informed within 2 hours.

title: CC-3 HPC Cluster Usage Policy
content: The High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster in CC-3 is strictly reserved for M.Tech, PhD researchers, and Faculty with approved research projects. All jobs must be submitted via SLURM job scheduler. Maximum job duration: 72 hours (extendable with HoD approval). Storage quota: 500 GB per user. GPU nodes (8x A100) are available for deep learning research. Apply for access at: hpc@iiita.ac.in

title: CC-1 Penrose Tiling & Architecture Guide
content: The iconic Penrose Tiling on the CC-1 main hall floors consists of aperiodic kites and darts — a mathematical marvel symbolizing the non-repeating, infinite possibilities of computation. The design was approved in 1999 by the founding director. CC-1 houses the undergraduate labs (Labs 101-112), faculty offices (Floor 2), and the main seminar hall (capacity: 500).

title: Library Rules & Access Policy
content: IIITA Central Library (CC-2) is open Monday-Saturday 8AM-11PM, Sunday 10AM-8PM. B.Tech students can borrow 4 books for 14 days. M.Tech/PhD students: 6 books for 21 days. Faculty: 10 books for 60 days. Overdue fine: Rs. 2/book/day. Digital library (IEEE Xplore, ACM DL, Springer) accessible on campus network at lib.iiita.ac.in. Lost book fine: 3x the book price.

title: Sports Complex & Gym Booking Policy
content: IIITA Sports Complex (near BH-5) is open 6AM-10PM daily. Facilities: Cricket ground, football field, basketball court, badminton courts (4), table tennis, gymnasium. Students must register their sports ID at the Sports Cell. Team bookings require 24-hour advance notice. Inter-hostel tournaments are organized every semester by the Sports Secretary. Gym membership: Rs. 500/semester.

title: Research Grant Application Process
content: Faculty may apply for Institute Research Grants (IRG) up to Rs. 10 Lakhs per project. Application portal: research.iiita.ac.in. Required: Research proposal (max 10 pages), budget breakdown, expected outcomes, and HoD endorsement. Review committee meets quarterly. External grants (SERB, DST, DRDO) require prior institutional approval. Overhead: 20% of grant amount goes to institute fund.

title: Teaching Load Norms for Faculty
content: As per IIITA norms: Assistant Professor: 12 hours/week teaching load. Associate Professor: 10 hours/week. Professor: 8 hours/week. HoD: 6 hours/week with additional administrative duties. Guest lectures and MOOC recordings count as 50% of contact hours. Teaching relief of up to 3 hours is granted for funded research projects above Rs. 20 Lakhs.

title: Conference Travel Grant Policy
content: Faculty presenting papers at indexed conferences (SCIE/Scopus/IEEE/ACM) are eligible for travel grants. International conferences: up to Rs. 1,50,000 (economy class, visa, registration). National conferences: up to Rs. 30,000. Application must be submitted 30 days before travel. Post-travel: report submission within 7 days and paper reprint mandatory. Grant is forfeited if paper is not presented in person.

title: Faculty Performance Review Criteria (Confidential)
content: Annual faculty appraisal is conducted by the Dean's office. Criteria: Teaching feedback score (30%), Publications in Q1/Q2 journals (30%), Research grants secured (20%), Institute service (10%), Student mentorship (10%). Scores below 60/100 for 2 consecutive years trigger a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP). Promotions require an average score of 75+ over 3 years.

title: Annual Departmental Budget Allocation 2026
content: Confidential — Dean's Office. IT Department: Rs. 85 Lakhs (Lab upgrades: 40L, Faculty research: 30L, Events: 15L). ECE Department: Rs. 72 Lakhs (Lab equipment: 35L, Research: 25L, Workshops: 12L). Management: Rs. 45 Lakhs. Central Infrastructure (CC-1, CC-2, CC-3): Rs. 2.1 Crores. Total Institute Budget 2026: Rs. 12.4 Crores. Budget review meeting: June 30, 2026.

title: MCM Scholarship Quotas & Disbursement 2026
content: Merit-cum-Means (MCM) Scholarship 2026. Total recipients: 85 students (15% of enrolled strength). Annual disbursement: Rs. 30,000/year per student. Eligibility: CGPA above 8.0 AND family income below Rs. 4.5 Lakhs/year. Renewal requires maintaining CGPA above 7.5. Currently awarded to: Aarav Sharma (iit2023001), Sanya Kapoor (itm2023078), and 83 others. Next verification: July 2026.

title: Disciplinary Committee Procedures
content: Disciplinary Committee (DC) is chaired by the Dean of Student Affairs. Cases referred: Ragging, academic dishonesty, hostel violations (3+ offences), property damage. Procedure: FIR filed → Student notice issued (48 hrs to respond) → DC hearing → Decision within 15 days. Appeals go to the Director. Punishments range from fine (Rs. 5,000-1,00,000) to expulsion. All DC proceedings are confidential.

title: Student Fee Structure 2025-26
content: B.Tech Tuition Fee: Rs. 1,25,000/semester. Hostel Fee: Rs. 18,000/semester (includes room). Mess charges: Rs. 2,800-3,200/month (actuals). Library fee: Rs. 500/semester. Sports fee: Rs. 500/semester. Medical fee: Rs. 1,000/year. Total estimated annual expenditure: Rs. 3.2-3.5 Lakhs. Fee due: July 31 (Sem 1), January 10 (Sem 2). Penalty for late payment: Rs. 100/day.

title: IT Department Course Offerings (Odd Sem 2025)
content: IT Department — Semester 5 Course List: CS-501 Algorithms (4 credits), CS-503 Database Systems (4 credits), CS-505 Computer Networks (4 credits), CS-507 Software Engineering (3 credits), CS-509 Operating Systems Lab (2 credits), Open Elective: CS-OE1 Machine Learning Fundamentals (3 credits). Faculty advisors for Semester 5 IT batch: Dr. S. K. Singh (Group A), Dr. Kavita Joshi (Group B).

title: ECE Department Lab Booking Policy
content: ECE department labs (Labs 201-208, CC-2) can be booked by students for project work between 4PM-8PM on weekdays. Booking must be done via the ECE lab portal (ecl.iiita.ac.in) at least 24 hours in advance. A faculty co-supervisor must be present for any experiment using high-voltage equipment. Equipment damage: student bears 50% of replacement cost.

title: Management Thesis Submission Guidelines
content: IT-Business (Management) final year students must submit their thesis by April 15. Format: IEEE double-column, minimum 40 pages. Plagiarism must be below 15% (Turnitin report mandatory). Thesis must be reviewed by the internal examiner and one external expert. Presentation is open to all. Softcopy submission on the academic portal; hardcopy to the department office.

title: Medical Facility & Health Insurance
content: IIITA has an on-campus medical facility (Health Centre) near GH-1, open 9AM-5PM weekdays, emergency care 24x7. A full-time doctor and nurse are available during working hours. Students are covered under a group health insurance policy (Rs. 2 Lakhs coverage per student, per year). Emergency ambulance: dial 0532-2922500. Specialist referrals are available at Tej Bahadur Sapru Hospital, Allahabad.

title: Anti-Ragging Policy & Helpline
content: IIITA strictly adheres to UGC Anti-Ragging Regulations 2009. Ragging in any form — physical, verbal, online — is a criminal offence. Punishment: FIR lodged with police, immediate suspension, and expulsion on proven guilt. Helpline: 1800-180-5522 (toll-free, 24x7). Anonymous complaints can be filed at antiragging.in. All freshers must sign an anti-ragging affidavit at the time of admission.
